sources.snippet: 📦 AI Delivery Route Optimizer An advanced Reinforcement Learning (RL) pathfinder and route optimization platform. The system trains off-policy Q-Learning agents to discover optimal delivery routes inside standardized environments (Taxi-v4) and custom warehouse grids containing obstacles.
